verdict.rationale: HumanLayer offers workflows with explicit review points before implementation: RPI and PRD-Oriented flows are recommended when behavior or code shape is unclear and needs more review before implementation. Tasks also provide shared task files with a place for comments and review, and reviewers can comment on synced documents. However, the evidence never shows a formal approval gate that blocks the agent from modifying the repository until a lead signs off on scope or contract. missing for 10: an explicit approve/reject gate that enforces no repo writes before sign-off, role-based approval for engineering leads, detailed docs on the plan/spec approval mechanics, and independent hands-on corroboration.
